item.title: AI execs may be too out of touch to build for the general public
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Tech leaders are flaunting how out of touch they are when they brag about using AI to connect with their families.

item.title: Trump DOE loans $5B to nuclear plants that will power data centers
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Constellation Energy will get $5 billion in government loans to modernize nuclear reactors. Most of the new capacity is already committed to Google, Amazon, and Meta.

item.title: South Korea’s financial industry hit by fresh wave of cyberattacks
item.dc:creator: Kate Park
item.description: South Korea’s financial institutions have been hit by another wave of cyberattacks, highlighting the growing risk of AI-driven hacking in Asia.

item.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.

item.title: Amazon debuts the Alexa Photo Frame and Echo Time smart clock, plus other upgraded devices
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Amazon's other new devices include an upgraded Echo Dot, an Echo Studio with visual intelligence features, and the Echo Show 16.

item.title: TikTok expands into restaurant guides with ‘Must Eat’ feature
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: The move puts TikTok in more direct competition with platforms like Yelp and Google.

item.title: Meta has a new AI pet app called Waddle World
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Meta has launched a new app called Waddle World, which essentially looks like a Tamagotchi clone, but with AI.

item.title: Free Fire returns to India as Garena launches localized version four years after ban
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Free Fire India was originally set to launch in September 2023, but Garena postponed its release.

item.title: Kodiak lands first commercial deal to supply driverless trucks for public highways
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The deal with DTL Transport puts it on a path to become an an asset-light tech supplier, rather than owner and operator.

item.title: 7 days until TechCrunch Founder Summit: Save up to $100 on your pass before doors open
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: In just 7 days, TechCrunch Founder Summit takes over Boston’s SoWa Power Station on November 4. Your chance to save up to $100 on tickets is running out, and the opportunity to learn and connect directly with experienced founders, investors, and startup leaders is almost here.

item.title: Jio shares surge 21% in market debut after blockbuster India IPO
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Jio has debuted as India's second-most valuable listed company, behind its parent, Reliance Industries.

item.title: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Massive note conversions reveal the true extent of Amazon's ownership in Anthropic.

item.title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February.

item.title: The data center boom has an upside: innovation for the US grid
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: As the AI boom stresses the existing power grid, all sorts of new opportunities for grid modernization are also emerging as a result, industry insiders say.

item.title: Guidewire buys Hyperexponential for $1.7B in cash
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: The deal, expected to close sometime next year, is to help bring AI agents to work alongside humans to underwrite, analyze, and price decisions.

item.title: From 8VC to Benchmark, here’s what’s hiding in October SEC filings
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: A whole crop of venture capital firms are raising significant new funds.

item.title: GM is embracing hybrids now
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: GM eschewed hybrids in favor of battery-electric vehicles. Now it's gearing up to offer hybrid versions of its SUVs.

item.title: Bank of America kindly asks that you don’t share your banking password with your AI assistant
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The banking giant reminds customers that "you're responsible for activity" resulting from your AI agents' access.

item.title: Who’s really in charge at Anthropic after the IPO?
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Here's a clear explanation of Anthropic's incredibly complex governance structure.

item.title: Discord is making its public communities more searchable, and people have concerns
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
